Business Law

This module helps you understand the legal framework that businesses, especially accountants and finance professionals, operate within.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Identify the essential elements of the legal system, including the main sources of law.

+  Explain and apply the law relating to employment relationships, negligence and criminal behaviour that may be encountered by professional accountants.

+  Explain the legal implications of incorporation, including the roles of shareholders and directors, and the main implications of insolvency law.

+  Discuss the role of contract law in the customer relationship.
